import networkx as nx

# Build wheel graph W_14
n = 14
hub = 0
edges = []
# spokes
for i in range(1, n):
    edges.append((hub, i))
# cycle
for i in range(1, n-1):
    edges.append((i, i+1))
edges.append((n-1, 1))  # close cycle

G = nx.Graph()
G.add_nodes_from(range(n))
G.add_edges_from(edges)

print("Number of vertices:", G.number_of_nodes())
print("Number of edges:", G.number_of_edges())
print("Edges:", edges)

# Compute vertex connectivity
kappa = nx.node_connectivity(G)
print("Vertex connectivity:", kappa)
